name: Warp
verdict: Build is $20 a month and includes $20 of agent usage at API rates, so extra use is pay-as-you-go. The free plan still includes the terminal and the agent CLI.

pricing.price: $20/mo, or $18/mo on the annual plan ($20 of agent usage included each month)
$200/mo, or $180/mo on the annual plan ($200 of agent usage included each month)
$50/user/mo, or $45/user/mo on the annual plan, up to 25 seats ($20 of usage per seat)

pros: Free plan includes the terminal and the Warp Agent CLI
Included agent usage is stated in dollars at API rates
Free plan can use your own API keys or a custom endpoint
cons: Build's included usage equals the $20 price, and extra use is pay-as-you-go
Free add-on usage is priced 20% higher than on paid plans
pricingNote: On 2026-10-14, https://www.warp.dev/pricing returned HTTP 200 with the title Pricing | Warp. The terminal and agents section listed Free at $0/month, Build at $20/month or $18/month on the annual plan, Max at $200/month or $180/month on the annual plan, Business at $50/user/month or $45/user/month on the annual plan for up to 25 seats, and Enterprise as custom. The FAQ on that page says Build includes $20 of agent usage each month, Business $20 per seat, and Max $200, and that Free add-on prices are 20% higher than paid-plan prices. The same page prices Warp Factories separately: pay as you go $0/month with usage at 20% above API rates, Build $20/month with usage at API rates, Business $50/user/month, Enterprise custom. It says factory usage is billed separately. It does not state a yearly dollar total, so none is shown.
